methodology.tours: Counts of retained open_tour events before cutoff, mapped by UUID, alias and @alias. Repeat opens count. No three-click threshold is applied.
methodology.leads: Saved lead records on canonical tours created before cutoff; no contact details included in this snapshot.
methodology.hours: Published current property website hours, applied retrospectively in America/New_York with DST. Opening included, closing excluded. Holidays and past hours changes not modeled. Office hours use indexed official property pages; main website unavailable at retrieval, so current hours were not independently confirmed.
methodology.lease_outcomes: Saved lead records created before cutoff whose leased flag is true at retrieval. These are recorded lease statuses, not independently verified signed documents or proof that the tour caused the lease. No signed date or lease revenue is inferred.
methodology.next_steps: Unique lead rows with metadata containing appointment date and start time, or explicit Question type with message/reason/notes. Histories deduplicated within each lead. Subsets of captured leads; categories may overlap. Metadata reflects retrieval-time state for leads created before cutoff. Scheduling indicates requests/bookings, not attendance.
methodology.geography: Distinct known locations in all tracked activity with complete country/region/city fields; portfolio locations deduplicated. Top five locations use open_tour events excluding flagged bots and unknown fields, matching dashboard exclusions of Pakistan, Philippines and city Sterling Heights. Provinces/states includes equivalent international regions.
methodology.content: Top three amenities and top one floor plan by button_click route counts (details_to, to, then details_route fallback), excluding flagged bots, overview, montage and form screens. Titles and media type use current configuration and may differ historically. Repeat selections count; no watch-duration/completion inference.

screen_views.definition: Derived recorded screen views: one initial screen view per retained open_tour event plus one view for each recorded button_click with a category.screen destination. Includes repeat opens/selections and all screen types; not unique people, distinct screens or completed video plays. Form/iframe events are not added separately to avoid double counting the same navigation. No visit-ID requirement because this metric counts events, not sessions.
screen_views.filters: Canonical UUID, alias and @alias combined, before the report cutoff; flagged bots excluded. Duplicate eventn_ctx_event_id values are counted once per property; if missing, exact timestamp/type/visit/origin/destination duplicates are collapsed.
screen_views.coverage: Based on retained events and inferred screen transitions, not playback confirmation. Historical navigation tracking varies by period. Clicks without a screen destination are excluded. Totals reflect recorded views, not every untracked screen impression.
screen_views.query:
WITH mapping AS (SELECT * FROM UNNEST([STRUCT('cc455e16-1e6c-4a23-9ffc-6b663589ff08' AS uuid, 'cc455e16-1e6c-4a23-9ffc-6b663589ff08' AS identifier),STRUCT('cc455e16-1e6c-4a23-9ffc-6b663589ff08' AS uuid, 'caycecove' AS identifier),STRUCT('cc455e16-1e6c-4a23-9ffc-6b663589ff08' AS uuid, '@caycecove' AS identifier)])), raw AS (
 SELECT m.uuid,e._timestamp,e.event_type,e.visit_uuid,e.eventn_ctx_event_id,
 COALESCE(NULLIF(e.details_to,''),NULLIF(e.`to`,''),NULLIF(e.details_route,'')) AS destination,
 COALESCE(e.details_from,e.`from`) AS origin
 FROM mapping m JOIN `default.events` e ON e.magnet_uuid=m.identifier
 WHERE e._timestamp<TIMESTAMP('2026-10-27T18:00:00+00:00') AND e.parsed_ua_bot IS NOT TRUE
 AND e.event_type IN ('open_tour','button_click')
), keyed AS (
 SELECT *,COALESCE(NULLIF(eventn_ctx_event_id,''),TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT(_timestamp,event_type,visit_uuid,destination,origin))) AS event_key
 FROM raw
), events AS (
 SELECT *,CASE WHEN STARTS_WITH(destination,'[') THEN ARRAY_TO_STRING(JSON_VALUE_ARRAY(destination),'.') WHEN STARTS_WITH(destination,'"') THEN JSON_VALUE(destination) ELSE destination END AS route
 FROM keyed QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY uuid,event_key ORDER BY _timestamp)=1
) SELECT uuid,COUNTIF(event_type='open_tour') AS initial_screen_views,
 COUNTIF(event_type='button_click' AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(route,r'^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$')) AS navigation_screen_views,
 COUNTIF(event_type='button_click' AND NOT COALESCE(REGEXP_CONTAINS(route,r'^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$'),FALSE)) AS excluded_non_screen_clicks,
 COUNTIF(event_type='button_click' AND route IS NOT NULL AND NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(route,r'^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$')) AS unclassified_destinations
 FROM events GROUP BY uuid ORDER BY uuid
